items.title: 15.7.2 Use and Abuse of Drugs (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the use and abuse of drugs (PDF 48-49).

blocks.text: "Use" (istemal) ka matlab tibbi (medical) maqsad ke liye drugs ka munasib ya doctor ka tajweez kardah istemal hai. "Abuse" (ghalat istemal) aam taur par psychoactive drugs ke na-munasib istemal ko kehte hain. Aage aam psychoactive drugs ke ghalat istemal ka bayan hai.

Yeh bohat nasha-awar opioid drug hai jo afeem ke poday (opium poppy) se hasil hoti hai. Ise injection, dhuein (smoking) ya naak se soongh kar liya jata hai. Yeh jhoota sarsoor (euphoria, yaani shadeed josh aur khushi) aur sukoon deti hai. Is ka istemal jaldi dependence aur lat tak le jata hai. Is ke kai jismani aur zehni nuqsanat hain, jaise saans ka dab jana (respiratory depression), infections aur zehni bimariyan.

Cannabis ek psychoactive drug hai jo Indian hemp (bhang) ke poday Cannabis sativa ke sookhe phool wale siron, patton aur tane se banti hai. Is mein marijuana aur hashish (charas) jaisi drugs shamil hain. Ise dhuein, bhaap (vapour) ya khane ki cheezon mein liya ja sakta hai. Cannabis ka istemal sukoon, sarsoor, badli hui samajh (altered perception) aur zyada bhook ka ehsas deta hai. Is ka lamba istemal bure asraat laata hai, jaise soch samajh (cognitive function) ki kharabi, saans ke masail aur zehni bimariyan.

Nicotine bohat nasha-awar drug hai jo tambakoo ki cheezon, jaise cigarettes, cigars aur baghair dhuein ke tambakoo, mein hoti hai. Is ka istemal lat aur dependence ke saath saath kai jismani aur zehni nuqsanat laata hai, jaise saans ke masail, cancers, dil aur khoon ki nalyon ki bimari (cardiovascular disease) aur zehni bimariyan.

Alcohol ek psychoactive drug hai jo kai shaklon, jaise beer, wine aur spirits, mein pi jati hai. Yeh sukoon aur sarsoor (shadeed khushi ya josh) ka ehsas deti hai. Is ke bure asraat mein soch aur harkat (cognitive aur motor functions) ki kharabi, jigar ki bimariyan, dil ki bimariyan aur zehni bimariyan shamil hain.

Inhalants, jaise nail polish remover aur gond (glue), psychoactive madde hain jinhein sarsoor, sukoon aur badli hui samajh ke liye soongha jata hai. Yeh sehat ke kai nuqsanat la sakte hain, jaise saans ke masail, soch ki kamzori aur asabi (neurological) nuqsan.

Drug abuse chhorne ki alamaat mein ghabrahat (anxiety), depression, thakan, be-chaini (agitation), mizaj ka baar baar badalna, kapkapi, sar dard, paseena, matli (nausea), bhook khatam hona, be-khwabi, dil ki tez dharkan, high blood pressure, waham (hallucinations: dekhne, sunne ya chhoone ke) aur dauray (seizures) shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Morphine ke use aur abuse mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Use: doctor shadeed dard ke liye naapi hui khuraak mein morphine tajweez karta hai. Abuse: tibbi zaroorat ke baghair sarsoor ke liye lena, jo dependence aur lat tak le jata hai.

items: Use = tibbi, tajweez kardah istemal; abuse = psychoactive drugs ka na-munasib istemal. Heroin (afeem se), cannabis (Cannabis sativa), nicotine (tambakoo), alcohol aur inhalants (nail polish remover, gond) sab sehat ko nuqsan dete hain; chhorne par bohat si withdrawal symptoms.
